name: Headmaster
source:
The headmaster of Reaper Training School with the appearance of a large owl. He once had the form of a human, but since that was thousands of years ago, few people know what he used to look like. He's always warmly watching over his students.

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.honeybee-cd.com/re_birth/chara_kouchou.html]official website profile[/URL].]
